Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You watch an opponent favor one leg, predict where their weight will fall, and strike the opening their next step leaves behind.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Your empty hand is enough. If you prefer a weapon, this card grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent; both use the same printed damage.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

A limp, a lifted elbow, the way the armor closes: attack what you understand. Use a melee weapon or your empty hand; this card supplies the damage.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; learn whether it has physical resistance.
Strong
5 physical damage; learn the physical resistance value and move 1 square without provoking.
